User request: No file is attached; this is the complete table in text: North: 2024 sales 100, 2025 sales 130; South: 2024 sales 80, 2025 sales 88. content.text:
No spreadsheet file was attached to inspect, so I computed from the values you provided.

- North: ((130 − 100) / 100) × 100% = (30 / 100) × 100% = 30% increase  
- South: ((88 − 80) / 80) × 100% = (8 / 80) × 100% = 10% increase
